edits.old: The masks identify the subject assigned to the node.
edits.new: The masks identify the subject assigned to the node. Define the subject and relationships named by the title itself. For ordinary subject titles, do not expand the definition to include every activity, setting, lifestyle, or act of sharing that can involve the subject. Avoid a catalogue of sampled examples. The complete posts explain what the selected masks refer to; their co-occurring details are not additional parts of the node definition.
